title: The Locked Study
author: Luna Engine Team
opening_text: Find a way to the garden.
help_text: Try examine the room, and interacting with what you see! type <green>help</green> for a list of commands.

endings.name: A quiet moment
endings.text: You stop to admire the rose. For now, this is enough.

endings.name: A gift for a loved one
endings.text: You stop to admire the rose. Avoiding the thorns carefully, you pick it. It will make a perfect gift for someone very special.
